record.field: Payments to new bank details are held

Detection after the money left is too late. With the payment hold on, Odoo refuses to post a payment to a bank account whose number was set in the last 30 days, or that Shield flagged, until someone other than the person who set the number verifies it.
Apply the one-click fix, then brief AP: when a payment is held, a colleague calls the vendor on a number you already had and clicks "Verify with Shield" on the bank account.
Flags vendors created in the last 12 months whose name imitates an existing vendor ("N0rthwind Logistics Ltd" vs "Northwind Logistics"): the classic fake-vendor and invoice-redirection set-up.
Confirm the new vendor's registration number and bank with the real company; archive it if it is a duplicate or fake.
New vendors not paid at once by their creator
Flags payments made within 7 days of the vendor being created, by the same person who created the vendor or its bank account.
Check the purchase order, delivery and contract behind the payment; require vendor creation and payment to be done by different people.
